title: Googly
desc: Sharath leads a carefree life until he meets Swathi at a college event. A friendship turns into a mutual attraction, but a small misunderstanding causes them to part ways.

title: Rajini Murugan
desc: Rajini Murugan, an out of work man, falls for Karthika but her father objects their relationship due to a misconception. Later, the situation improves after Rajini inherits his grandfather's property.

title: HIT: The Third Case
desc: The Homicide Intervention Team dispatches relentless officer Arjun Sarkar to track down a band of murderers and put an end to their gruesome killing spree.

title: Big Octopus
desc: A fisherman and his friend catch a strange octopus from the sea. However, they accidentally get involved in a conspiracy about genetic mutations.

title: Vettai Puli
desc: A newly appointed officer is tasked with eliminating an extortion gang in the city. Unbeknownst to him, the gang's leader is someone close to him.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Chakra
desc: A carefully planned mass robbery causes a police officer and a soldier to team up with each other and carry out an investigation, which reveals a vast syndicate of cybercriminals.
